title: Country Loaf: Two Boules, One Dutch Oven
constraints: the two loaves bake one after the other
notes: Fermentation dominates: the levain ripen, the bulk ferment and the overnight retard are all variable, and their defaults set the clock. The dutch oven is heated from a point inside the retard (event=start plus an offset) so it is at temperature the moment the dough comes out. The second loaf waits for the first to leave the oven and for a ten-minute re-heat; the two loaves only share the cooling rack.
